explanation: Type II Hypersensitivity involves IgG or IgM antibodies binding to an antigen on a cell surface or tissue structure (like the glomerular basement membrane in Goodpasture syndrome). This binding leads to complement activation and cellular destruction. Type III involves circulating immune complexes that deposit in tissues.
